17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans — 2125-27 South Archer Avenue, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning: C2-5 Motor Vehicle-Related Commercial District
Lot Area: Approximately 6,507 Square Feet

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to develop the subject property with a new four-
story commercial building that will contain four (4) commercial units. The
subject property is a Transit Served Location and will not provide off-street
parking. The proposed building will measure approximately 55 ft. tall and
the commercial units will contain approximately 6,180 sq. ft. of floor area.
Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and
Variation of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, and pursuant to Sec. 17-13-
1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the off-street parking
requirement to zero and is seeking all zoning relief, as needed and as
allowed by the Chicago Zoning Code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 24,923 square feet (3.83 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): No residential units proposed.

(C) The amount of off-street parking: None

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location and pursuant to Sec.
17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to reduce the required number of off-street
parking spaces to zero.

() — Setbacks:

a. Front Setback: zero
b. Side Setbacks:
Southeast Side: Zero
Southwest Side: zero
c. Rear Setback: zero

(E) Building Height: 55 feet (68 feet as measured to the top of the roof access enclosure)
